title: The Secret Path Through the Whispering Forest
moral: Courage and kindness can bring people together.

scenes.text: Thomas explores a forest to create a path between two villages and meets Eliza in a strange clearing.
scenes.image_prompt: young boy with map in magical forest with glowing sunlight and ancient stones

scenes.text: They find spiral-arranged stones and an ancient map suggesting a forgotten path.
scenes.image_prompt: children examining spiral stone pattern in forest clearing

scenes.summary: They face dangers in the forest.
scenes.text: They cross broken bridges, encounter a bear, and navigate through unknown terrain.
scenes.image_prompt: kids crossing broken wooden bridge over stream in forest

scenes.text: An old woman tests their intentions and allows them to continue after proving their kindness.
scenes.image_prompt: mysterious old forest guardian surrounded by glowing trees

scenes.summary: They build a path for everyone.
scenes.text: They create a safe path connecting villages, bringing people together.
scenes.image_prompt: villagers crossing new forest bridge happily during sunset celebration

story: Thomas and Eliza explore a mysterious forest to create a path between two villages. Along the way, they face dangers and solve mysteries. By showing courage and kindness, they succeed and bring people together through their new path.
